bounded_component.cache_reference: Independent O(N^2) all-particle Wendland search, same stored fields and current C, GJ=sum Vj(Jj-Ji)Ci gradW. Per-node ki=k0 exp[(J-1)/((1-n0)Ck)],uk=(Kw/n)|alpha ki GJ|/gamma,gamma=rhow*9.80665. Max over actual normal fluid only; positive max and all native pressure rates exactly0 required.
bounded_component.gate: Actual max and independently computed max agree within5e-13*max(abs(reference),DBL_MIN). GetDynamicStepScales remains pure current-J/k wave and diffusion, each matched to same relative ledger bound. New complete bound=min(old complete bound,Safety*h/actual cached max), independently matched; require new<=.5old before request tests. This is a local necessary scale, not sufficient variable-coefficient stability.
bounded_component.OMP: For each dimension/jitter use actual OMP1 thenOMP2 with both OmpThreads and omp_set_num_threads set consistently. Require byte-identical actual native rates, maximum cache and selected dt vectors across threads.
bounded_component.requests: Each of8 active fixtures calls actual DtVariable(false) in8 cases: variable safe,current .25new; fixed .5new with minimum .125new; fixed at actual new bound; current midway between actual old/new rejected; fixed midway rejected; DtMin midway rejected; DtMin .75new above fixed .5new rejected; current at new bound accepted. At-bound requests use the actual formula bound after independent reference agreement, avoiding an independently rounded boundary request. Require expected exception category,DtModif0 and all covered physical/native arrays/clock byte-unchanged.
bounded_component.reset_negative_checks: Only deliberate stale-cache tests assign DBL_MAX: actual rate with k0 must reset0, lawOFF must reset0, uniformJ1 lawON must reset0. Then restore affineJ/lawON and require actual helper freshly reproduces original positive cache byte-exactly. Pressure/Ace/theta stay0. Never use poisoned max for active limit or pretend zero driving means zero coefficient-transport speed.
